title: Chiquipoli: interval and exact verification for the local maximality of A16
description: Interval-arithmetic and exact-rational certification of the first-order hypotheses for the Bingane-Audet equilateral small hexadecagon, with a Lean 4 formalisation of the criterion itself, so that the passage from the certified data to strict local maximality is kernel checked end to end. Also covered: the Bingane-Audet family A16 to A1024 in Julia, and A16 to A256 in Lean by kernel-checked data. A Lean proof shows, for every n = 16k, that the polygon built by the published constructor is feasible and a strict local maximiser of the perimeter. An explicit radius of strict local maximality is given for A16. Supplementary material for the article "First Order Geometry of Equilateral Small Polygons".
